entries.ff08baacaf8de706: This business makes lithium-ion battery separators, ion-exchange membranes, hollow fiber filtration membranes and other products. A separator is a membrane that separates the positive and negative electrodes inside a battery; it is manufactured by Asahi Kasei Battery Separator and by companies in Canada and the United States. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company states that it recognized indications of impairment on the assets of Asahi Kasei Battery Separator following slower growth in the electric vehicle market.
